results.name: Thunderfury
results.pinDescription: Blasts your enemy with lightning, dealing 300 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies.  Each jump reduces that victim's Nature resistance by 25. Affects 5 targets. Your primary target is also consumed by a cyclone, slowing its attack speed by 20% for 12 sec.

results.name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
results.pinDescription: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker is the legendary sword once wielded by Thunderaan, Prince of Air.

results.name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
results.pinDescription: Wielder of Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker.

results.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
results.pinDescription: You have defeated the Wind Seeker. Take the dormant blade and force the lying wretch, Demitrian, to use the materials you provided for his betrayal to wake Thunderfury.

results.name: How to Complete Your Thunderfury in Phase 3 - WoW Classic Fresh
results.pinDescription: Phase 3 of the 20th Anniversary Servers introduces the final steps players will need to take to obtain their [item=19019]!

results.name: How to Acquire Thunderfury in Season of Discovery Phase 5
results.pinDescription: Season of Discovery Phase 5 has opened the doors to [url guide=26980]Blackwing Lair[/url], and now players will finally be able to get their hands on [item=230224]!

results.name: Possible Thunderfury-Themed Cloak on Season of Discovery PTR
results.pinDescription: There might be a fun bonus Thunderfury-themed item in store for players in Season of Discovery based on the Patch 1.15.4 PTR!

results.name: Thunderfury Model Size Adjusted on Classic Realms
results.pinDescription: With the launch of Season of Discovery Patch 1.15.3, eagle-eyed players have noticed a change to Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker - it's gotten significantly smaller.

results.name: Thunderfury Will Not Be Changing in Season of Discovery Phase 4
results.pinDescription: As we prepare for Phase 4 Season of Discovery, it has felt like every item has had some huge changes. So some players were relieved too learn that [item=19019] will not be changed.
